properties.source: Drawn by hand from Britannica's text description, not its map images. Schematic line through the cities and lakes the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal is documented to pass (Britannica 'Grand Canal'; UNESCO WHS 1443): Tongzhou, Tianjin, Cangzhou, Dezhou, Linqing, Liaocheng, Jining, Weishan Lake, Pizhou, Suqian, Huai'an, Gaoyou, Yangzhou, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Wuxi, Suzhou, Jiaxing, Hangzhou. City coordinates are general knowledge; the course between them is approximate.
